_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Standard (041), Series WX1YZ/5, SET-2. 27 page images: idx 0 bilingual cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions + Hindi Q1-2; English on every even index 2-26, Hindi on every odd index 3-25 (each the Hindi of the page after it). Odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet: all open in Hindi, none carries English overflow; idx 26 is the last page and is English (Q38 (iii)). Numbering runs 1-38 unbroken across the English pages. General Instructions (i)-(x) confirm full80. Instruction (viii) prints 2 internal choices in B, 2 in C, 2 in D and 3 in E: Q23, Q24, Q29, Q31, Q32, Q35, Q36, Q37, Q38, each found as a printed OR on the paper and each confirmed by a bare OR in the marking scheme for 30/5/2 (which is set-specific: footer MS_X_Mathematics_041_30/5/2_2022-23); no other OR in the scheme. Section-A keys read off the scheme as images and each re-derived: all agree; no void notes. Decimal points are RAISED dots on this paper (Q5, Q7, Q10, Q12, Q33, Q37). Sibling of 30/5/1: 41 of 53 rows match the reference by content and were copied from data/2023-30-5-1.questions.json after reading each on this paper; 12 rows are new (Q1, Q3, Q4, Q15, Q16, Q18, Q22, Q25, Q26, Q27, Q30, Q34). plan.txt was not used to skip anything.

questions.context: Questions number 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions carrying 1 mark each. Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Select the correct answer to these questions from the codes (a), (b), (c) and (d) as given below.
questions.stem:
**Assertion (A) :** The number \(5^n\) cannot end with the digit 0, where n is a natural number.

**Reason (R) :** Prime factorisation of 5 has only two factors, 1 and 5.

options.label: A
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: B
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is **not** the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.

options.label: D
options.text: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
